pages.text: The Transformer, a machine that calls a deer a horse:$(li)$(2,4)Lapis Dust → Cooling Base$(0)$(li)Minerals (ingots/blocks) → matching Ore Bases$(br2)It disguises ordinary minerals as advanced materials — the catalyst and fusion heat sinks both need it to pave the way.

The Cooling Base is the starting point of the cooling system: mix it with dusts tier by tier, from iron dust all the way to netherite ingots.$(br)No matter how hot it gets, every heat sink starts here.
